line.name: Joya de Nicaragua Cuatro Cinco Secret Cask
line.filler: 100% Nicaraguan, including five-year-aged ligero matured in charred white-oak casks that previously held spirits
line.background_text: Cuatro Cinco Secret Cask pays homage to the original 2013 Cuatro Cinco Edición Limitada, JDN's 45th-anniversary release and the first cigar in its Obras Maestras ultra-premium collection, which sold out its 4,500-box run. Secret Cask uses the identical all-Nicaraguan puro blend but with tobacco aged in charred oak spirit casks set aside in 2013. Released November 2025 in a limited run of 1,500 boxes of 10 (700 allocated to the U.S.), each box includes a small 'mini-casket' of filler tobacco replicating the aging process.

vitolas.summary_review: Halfwheel scored it 92; medium-to-full body with a progression from creamy/pepper opening through chocolate-and-wood middle to tangy cedar finish.

critic_reviews.key_notes_text: Mild-to-medium strength, medium-plus body; creaminess and bran muffin with black pepper opening, layered chocolate/wood/pepper middle, tangy cedar finish.

research_notes: CONFIRMED distinct from Edición Europa and Pata Negra: Secret Cask returns to the ORIGINAL all-Nicaraguan puro 2013 blend (no Dominican binder, unlike Reserva Especial/Europa/Pata Negra), uses a unique cask-aging story, and comes in a distinct 6x54 box-pressed format only. Exact price not confirmed.
